question: Among molecules that contain at least one atom of calcium or sulfur and have at least one double or triple bond, determine whether carcinogenic ('+') or non-carcinogenic ('-') labels are more common.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom AS a
        WHERE a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
          AND a.XCL_003 IN ('ca', 's')
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond AS b
        WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
          AND b.XCL_006 IN ('=', '#')
    )
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN '+'
        ELSE '-'
    END AS more_common_label
FROM qualifying_molecules AS qm
INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON qm.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010

    FROM molecule AS m

        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

        ELSE '-'
    END AS more_common_label
FROM qualifying_molecules AS qm
INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON qm.XCL_010 = m.XCL_010

    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('s', 'ca')
      AND b.XCL_006 IN ('=', '#')
),
car_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
    FROM qualifying_molecules qm

)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN carcinogenic_count > non_carcinogenic_count THEN '+'
        WHEN non_carcinogenic_count > carcinogenic_count THEN '-'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common_label
FROM car_counts
